title: cross-solver canonical case output
description: Standardised output record. primary_quantities are the numbers the solver claims; derived_quantities are recomputed by the frame from primary ones (component decompositions, ratios); conservation_residuals are the physical gates; convergence carries the discretisation evidence used by the adjudicator to decide whether two numbers may be compared at all.

primary_quantities.description: artifact-native output numbers keyed by canonicalised name; empty is a hard error (see negative control C4)

canonical_quantities.description: subset of primary_quantities that maps onto a canonical platform quantity (C_T/C_F/C_W/...); needed for cross-solver comparison

quantity_paths.description: where inside the source artifact each primary quantity was read from (audit trail)
